description: One data row of central/alert_events.csv, read as an object of column name to cell text; an empty cell is null. The header row must be exactly the columns of x-columns, in that order. Generated from meterline_gold/write.py and meterline_gold/dataset_docs.py by meterline_gold.contract; do not edit by hand. Meaning of each column: docs/reference/gold-datasets.md and the gold spec, sections 6 to 8.

scenario_id.description: Id of the shadow scenario from the policy.

schema_version.description: GOLD_SCHEMA_VERSION of the build that wrote the file; the same on every row.

subject_key.description: person_key or unit_id, as subject_kind says; for proxy, the proxy's provider and the provider it routes to, joined by a slash.

threshold.description: Limit the event crossed, in the reference currency.

trailing_days.description: Days in the spike's trailing window; empty on other events.

trailing_sum.description: Sum of the day costs in the spike's trailing window; empty on other events.

value.description: Day cost or position that fired the event; for proxy_overlap, the amount counted twice.

title: gold-dataset-alert_events
x-cost-column-rule: `value` and `threshold` are day or position costs; do not sum events. A `proxy_overlap` event carries the amount that two providers' rows both count.
x-grain: One row per event; nothing is sent.
